propositions: RP-05 establishes a single immutable top-level command registry with lazy handler and parser-factory references to normalize help across 21 commands and make parser-derived generated help a public compatibility boundary.

ADR 0100 must record the approved design: stdlib-only argparse factories as the single grammar source, deterministic help generation, pre-operation routing before snapshot/config/mount, and semantic capability enforcement with error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures.
The ADR draft received explicit maintainer approval on 2026-08-18 via the research ticket and must be recorded verbatim with no added decisions before Gerrit Submit.

Acceptance criteria require verification that the ADR cites approved research, prohibits docs-only grammars, does not contradict ADR 0098, and passes document oracle checks (ADR numbering bijection and generated index).
Implementation of RP-05 child tasks must be blocked until the exact ADR draft receives explicit maintainer approval, both Gerrit gates pass, and the ADR lands.
